name: Hydro DMG
description:
Applies Hydro and can trigger the following Elemental Reactions:
Every 1 Elemental Mastery increases the specified effect by a factor of 1
Vaporize: DMG +100% for this instance, with every 8 Elemental Mastery contributing an additional 100%
Electro-Charged: Deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters
Frozen: Apply 4 stacks of Frostbite to the target
Bloom: Create 1 stack of Dendro Core
